title: 21st.dev
usage:
Example pattern for this catalog. Not an official snippet.

Browse a component, then install that registry item into your own repo:

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add "<registry-url-from-the-component-page>"
```

Browsing is free. Daily free copies are limited; membership unlocks more copies and premium templates. Confirm the component's own license before shipping it.
notes: Example catalog record, written by hand for the scaffold — not crawled. 21st.dev is a community registry of React and Tailwind components, templates, and shadcn themes in the shadcn registry format. Code is copied into your repo rather than imported from a runtime package. Per-component licenses differ. The platform source repository is MIT.
